title: Aldwin
description: An open-source personal assistant that runs on your own computer, built on agentling.

home.title: New chat
home.description: Start a conversation with Aldwin, the assistant running on this computer.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.description: A saved conversation with Aldwin, kept on this computer.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose Aldwin's model, search, skills, connected apps, limits and look.

connect.title: Connect a model
connect.description: Choose the model Aldwin uses: an API key, a local model, or another OpenAI-compatible server.

name.title: Your name
name.description: Tell Aldwin what to call you. You can skip this step.

occupation.title: Your work
occupation.description: Tell Aldwin what you do, so answers fit your work. You can skip this step.

personality.title: Answer style
personality.description: Pick how Aldwin should answer you. You can skip this step.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist in Aldwin.
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.
